title: Federal Republic of Germany
capsule: West Germany (Bundesrepublik Deutschland) was established on 23 May 1949 from the American, British, and French occupation zones following Allied victory in World War II, becoming a founding member of NATO (1955) and the European Economic Community (1957) and renouncing weapons of mass destruction. Under the Wirtschaftswunder ('economic miracle') steered by Economics Minister Ludwig Erhard, it became Western Europe's largest economy by the 1960s. Chancellor Helmut Kohl's government negotiated reunification after the fall of the Berlin Wall (9 November 1989); on 3 October 1990 the five reconstituted East German states acceded to the Basic Law, and the Federal Republic expanded to encompass all of Germany.
